name: gitignore
description: Create and maintain .gitignore files from a curated, conservative template library. Adds user-specified entries by default, or composes OS-specific (macOS, Windows, Linux) and language-specific (Node.js, Python, Java, Kotlin, C, Go, Elixir) sections without hiding lockfiles, manifests, or other legitimately versioned files.
